# Attributes

Attributes are the columns, and the query attributes, that *digna* profiles in a data source. Authentication, pagination and errors are described in the [Overview](index.md).

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/attributes` | [List attributes](#get-attributes) |
| `POST` | `/v1/attributes` | [Create an attribute](#create-attribute) |
| `GET` | `/v1/attributes/{attribute_id}` | [Get an attribute](#get-attribute) |
| `PUT` | `/v1/attributes/{attribute_id}` | [Update an attribute](#update-attribute) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/attributes/{attribute_id}` | [Delete an attribute](#delete-attribute) |

---

## List attributes {: #get-attributes }

```http
GET /v1/attributes
```

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data_source_id` | query | integer | Yes | Filter by data source ID |
| `limit` | query | integer | No | Maximum number of rows to return (default: 200, max: 5000) |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List attributes | array of [Attribute](#attribute) |
| `400` | Invalid limit | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://digna.example.com/v1/attributes?data_source_id=<data_source_id>' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIGNA_API_KEY"
```

## Create an attribute {: #create-attribute }

```http
POST /v1/attributes
```

**Request body**: [CreateAttributeRequest](#createattributerequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Create an attribute | [Attribute](#attribute) |
| `400` | Invalid attribute definition | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `403` | Not authorized | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `404` | Not found | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://digna.example.com/v1/attributes' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIGNA_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "category": "NUMERICAL",
    "data_source_id": 1,
    "name": "<name>",
    "statistic_ids": [
      1
    ]
  }'
```

## Schemas {: #schemas }

### CreateAttributeRequest {: #createattributerequest }

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `category` | [StableAttributeCategory](#stableattributecategory) | Yes |  |
| `column` | string, nullable | No | COLUMN only: the source column to read. Defaults to `name`. |
| `data_source_id` | integer | Yes |  |
| `data_type` | string | No | Stored empty for a QUERY attribute, whatever is sent. |
| `description` | string, nullable | No | Business meaning of the attribute. Defaults to an empty string. |
| `expression` | string, nullable | No | QUERY only: the SQL expression to read. |
| `kind` | [StableAttributeKind](#stableattributekind), nullable | No | COLUMN or QUERY. Without it, an `expression` makes the attribute QUERY and anything else COLUMN. |
| `name` | string | Yes | The label, unique within the data source. |
| `statistic_ids` | array of integer | Yes |  |

### StableAttributeCategory {: #stableattributecategory }

One of: `NUMERICAL`, `CATEGORICAL`, `OTHER`, `DATE`, `CUSTOM`.

### ApiErrorCode {: #apierrorcode }

One of: `INTERNAL_ERROR`, `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`, `NOT_FOUND`, `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, `NOT_AUTHORIZED`, `INVALID_LICENSE`, `BAD_REQUEST`.
